messages:
emma: Morning all — async standup: drop what you worked on yesterday, any blockers, and plan today. I'll kick it off.

rohit: WIP - finished model crop for doc-rerank onboarding. Uploaded quantized weights to s3://redwood-models/rerank/v2-q4. No blockers. Today: run full eval sweep + PR for model card. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/842 :rocket:

jen: Yesterday: added prompt-set v3 for support tickets, ran local eval. Saw small hallucination uptick on 'case_summary' slot (F1 down ~2.3%). Blocker: need a few labeled examples for slot calibration. Today: propose to add 200 seed labels and rerun. @rohit can you share sample outputs from v2-q4?

rohit: pasted samples below.
```
INPUT: 'User can't login, 2FA failing after password reset'
PRED: 'User can't log in. Suggest password reset and check 2FA.'
```
Noted the slot mismatch — will dump more examples to gist: https://gist.github.com/rohit/sample-raises

mike: Yesterday: merged batching improvements to runtime (see eng-runtime PR #1197). No regression in latency in perf tests. Today: enabling continuous batching on a small fleet for canary. Ping if you see degraded tail latency.

eval-bot: [alert] evals/run/2026-03-16: rerank-v2-q4 -> CU1: NDCG dropped 0.06 vs baseline. Threshold exceeded.

emma: Thanks — noted the NDCG alert. Can we triage quickly: is this within prompt-set differences or model change? @jen @rohit

jen: I think prompt_set v3 is slightly more aggressive (shorter context). I'll run a matched prompt-set eval (v2 prompts on new model) to disambiguate.

rohit: I'll run the model-against-old-prompts test in the morning. ETA ~2h. If NDCG drop persists, we can roll back quantization profile to q5 on the canary pool.

mike: FYI patched a metrics tag to include prompt_set id so we can filter by that in console.

jen: small request — adding an eval that reports per-slot precision/recall would help. Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/issues/561

emma: Nice. Action items: (1) @jen run matched-prompt eval, post results here; (2) @rohit run old-prompt test (ETA 2h); (3) @mike hold canary scaling if NDCG < threshold. We'll do quick huddle if both confirm regression. If not, proceed with planned onboarding. :thumbsup:

mike: ack.

rohit: ack — starting test now.

jen: starting matched prompts eval, will post matrix when done.

emma: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks the canary deploy, DM me. Otherwise I'll check back in this afternoon. :wave:
